text:
vela: quick RFC follow-up: proposing a "tethered-executors" pattern to tighten service boundaries on the hotpath. idea: keep executors stateless, move per-tenant affinity/state into small tenant-facing tether service. goal: reduce blast radius of KV churn and make rollbacks per-tenant instead of whole-cluster.

oscar: can you outline the migration stages at a high level?

vela: Stage 0: router emits tether headers and shadows calls to a tether read service (observe). Stage 1: tether serves reads for a small pilot (read-through only). Stage 2: enable writes for opted-in tenants with async reconcile. Stage 3: expand and flip.

june: latency tail is my worry. extra hop could hurt p95. how do we keep batching semantics intact?

vela: executors keep batching and KV reads for minibatches. tether only does affinity lookups, prefix hints, and per-tenant sharding. router keeps a short LRU (100-200ms) for last-known tether mapping to avoid RPC on steady-state. co-locate tether where possible.

mark: ops + SLO note: start with micro-canary 0.1% at peak, 2% off-peak. run 48h windows. auto-rollback if p95 > baseline + 18% or error rate increase >0.05% abs for 15m.

oscar: migration tech-debt: customers have heuristics embedded in enrichment. plan for parity?

vela: we'll provide a shim in tether that proxies specified enrichment keys to legacy enrichment during transition. long-term, migrate heuristics into enrichment adapters and remove shim.

june: observability checklist: per-tenant tether-hit/miss, tether_rpc_duration, executor_batch_size, token-latency by route, output-diff alerts. tag spans with "tether_phase" and "executor_ver".

mark: config snippet for weighted canary routing we can wire into Console:
```
route:
  strategy: weighted
  targets:
    - name: legacy-executor
      weight: 99.9
    - name: tethered-executor
      weight: 0.1
fallback:
  timeout_ms: 120
  fallback_target: legacy-executor
```

oscar: test harness: replay 25k historical sessions with jitter, run golden-diff on top-50 tenants. thresholds: classifier label drift <0.2%, generative delta <1.0 BLEU-like. include hallucination-sensitive prompts.

june: migration backfill: snapshot top-k prefixes per tenant and stream into tether store with backpressure. nightly reconciliation for 7 days while shadowing 100% traffic for monitoring; only flip writes after mismatch rate <0.05%.

mark: cost: tether adds RPCs and CPU. roll out to low-cost tenants first and model delta per-1k reqs. vela: please add cost table to RFC.

ops-bot: infra: feature-flag "tether_observe" created and ticket ARCH-9001 "tethered-executors rollout" assigned to vela. CI: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/99221

vela: will draft RFC follow-up with timeline (2w spike, 3w infra prep, 4-8w staged rollout), risk matrix, playbook, and dashboard mocks. tagging reviewers: @oscar @june @mark. :rocket:
